scripts.start: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --ui "npm --prefix functions run seed:emulator && npm run emulators:banner && tail -f /dev/null"
scripts.emulators:banner:
node -e "const p=require('./firebase.json').emulators.ui.port; console.log('
✔ Emulators running + seeded. Emulator UI: http://127.0.0.1:'+p+'
  (Ctrl-C to stop)
')"
